name: Touch of Fascination
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target of this spell is fascinated for the duration.
